note: T-88 (M3): picks over invented lab records, each answer worked out BY HAND from the rules below, never by either engine. A consumer loads the records into a table of (collection, key, data jsonb), runs each case through BOTH engines (the statement from picks.builder / picks.group, and picks.pyrunner), and requires each to equal `expect` exactly (numbers compared as exact decimals). RULES: (1) a time is a calendar date YYYY-MM-DD or the fixed-width UTC time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (hours 00-23, minutes and seconds 00-59), a real day; read as UTC, a date is its midnight; any other value (missing, null, empty text, a number, another text form, an impossible day) puts the record in NO time bucket. (2) Weeks start on Monday (UTC) and are named by that Monday; months by their first day; every label is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. A bucket with no records is not returned. (3) Blank is a missing field or JSON null: it is its own group; an empty text "" is a value, its own group. (4) A total or average is exact over the values stored as JSON numbers (text, booleans, lists are left out), rounded half-up to 6 decimal places; a count counts records. (5) Buckets come in time order; groups in the order of their value (blank last). (6) A field whose name is not a plain identifier is named in brackets, the expression language's own spelling: ["Sample Weight (g)"]; a.b for plain keys.

cases.name: count per week (Monday start; Sunday 23:59:59 is the week before; a date is its midnight)
count per day (UTC: 23:00 on Dec 31 stays Dec 31)
count per hour (a date-only value is its midnight hour)
average over everything: 22.5 / 7, half-up to 6 places (text and booleans left out)
count per category: blank (missing or null) its own group, empty text its own value
average per category, exact (blank's text "5" left out)
a field named with spaces and brackets: average Sample Weight (g) = 8 / 3 ("n/a" left out)
count per a field named with a space: Sample Type (blank: the eight without one)
